title: Soul Snack #59: How Can I Heal Anxiety?
excerpt: Your emotions are messages from your soul.
bodyHtml:
Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn How to Tune In and Listen Here.

In this Soul Snack, Gary Zukav explores what anxiety truly is – and what it isn’t. He reveals that the vague, overwhelming feeling so many call “generalized anxiety” is actually emotional illiteracy: the inability to recognize and name the physical sensations that accompany our emotions.

True healing begins not with suppression or medication, but with awareness.

Gary guides listeners to look inward – to the energy processing centers (the throat, chest, and solar plexus) – where emotions manifest as sensations. By identifying these feelings precisely, we dissolve the fog of fear and reclaim our power of choice. Each sensation, he explains, is a message from the soul, inviting us to move from reaction to responsibility.

Healing anxiety, then, is not about eliminating discomfort but learning from it. When we name and feel our emotions rather than numbing them, we create authentic power – the ability to choose love over fear in every moment.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

  • (00:02) — Anxiety as a Messenger
    Why “generalized anxiety” is too vague to heal—and how becoming emotionally literate transforms your experience.
  • (01:13) — The Practice of Emotional Literacy
    How to turn inward and identify the specific physical sensations that reveal your emotional state.
  • (03:48) — Naming the Pain Removes the Fear
    How describing sensations precisely (tightness, pressure, burning) dissolves the “boogeyman” of anxiety.
  • (05:22) — The Myth of Tranquilizers
    Why medicating emotional pain only numbs it temporarily—and what it means to make a responsible, conscious choice instead.
  • (06:03) — Choosing Authentic Power
    How recognizing your role as the source of your pain opens the path to freedom, love, and inner strength.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

This week, notice moments when you feel anxious or unsettled. Pause and bring your attention to your throat, chest, or solar plexus. Describe what you feel – tension, heat, constriction – and stay with it. Ask yourself: What is this feeling teaching me? Each time you recognize an emotion instead of running from it, you strengthen your emotional literacy and move closer to authentic power.
